# Kobrossi Systems

> Kobrossi Systems is a business consultant for small businesses in New York's Capital Region. John Paul Kobrossi finds what's costing an owner time or money and builds the fix: a website and local SEO, a CRM and texting system, or custom software, priced on the job.

## Key facts
- Category: local business consulting: websites, local SEO, CRM/texting systems, custom software
- Best for: small business owners in the Capital Region, NY (within about an hour of Menands, NY)
- Three ways to start:
  - The Online Starter Kit ($1,000): a website built to be found, plus Google Business Profile and local SEO.
  - The Follow-Up System ($2,000): everything in the Starter Kit, plus a CRM set up underneath it (pipeline, missed-call texting, review requests).
  - The Diagnostic (quoted after a walkthrough): a business review to find where time or money is being lost, then a priced fix.
- Direct: John Paul works every project himself, not a call center or an agency roster.
- Website: https://www.getjobtally.com

## What makes it different
- Consulting first, not a product pitch: the offer is finding the actual problem, not a fixed line item.
- Local: Capital Region, NY, will travel up to an hour, meets clients in person.
- Real, named client work, checkable by visiting the actual live sites (see the homepage's "Work I've actually shipped" section).

## JobTally
JobTally, a job-costing and crew-management app for contractors, was previously sold as a self-serve
$150/mo SaaS product at this domain. That self-serve product is retired (no self-serve signup, no
free trial as of September 2026). JobTally still exists as a custom build: John Paul will build a
version of it for a specific business that asks and pays for it, priced like any other custom
software project, not as a subscription.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.getjobtally.com/): the consulting offer, the three ways to start, client work, contact
- [JobTally for your business](https://www.getjobtally.com/remodelers): custom JobTally builds, for anyone specifically interested
- [Live demo of JobTally](https://www.getjobtally.com/demo): tap through the underlying app with sample data, no signup
